paragraphs.source_en: As the litter approached the city and was descried from the walls, the people poured forth to gaze once more on the face of their hero. Foremost of all, the mother and the wife of Hector came, and at the sight of the lifeless body renewed their lamentations. The people all wept with them, and to the going down of the sun there was no pause or abatement of their grief.

units.source_en: As the litter approached the city and was descried from the walls, the people poured forth to gaze once more on the face of their hero.
Foremost of all, the mother and the wife of Hector came, and at the sight of the lifeless body renewed their lamentations.
The people all wept with them, and to the going down of the sun there was no pause or abatement of their grief.

paragraphs.source_en: The next day preparations were made for the funeral solemnities. For nine days the people brought wood and built the pile, and on the tenth they placed the body on the summit and applied the torch; while all Troy thronging forth encompassed the pile. When it had completely burned, they quenched the cinders with wine, collected the bones and placed them in a golden urn, which they buried in the earth, and reared a pile of stones over the spot.
